# Lab 8.16: Just-in-time Access with PAM

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a Privileged Access Manager entitlement so Bob can request temporary admin access, approved by Sam.

## Steps

1. **Enable the API.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable privilegedaccessmanager.googleapis.com</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Create the entitlement in the console.** Go to **IAM & Admin → Privileged Access Manager → Entitlements → Create**.
   - Name: `temp-compute-admin`
   - Role: **Compute Admin**
   - Maximum duration: **1 hour**
   - Requesters: `bob@yourdomain`
   - Approvers: `sam@yourdomain`, 1 approval needed
   - Require justification: on

   The same with gcloud uses a YAML file:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • YAML
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">privilegedAccess:
  gcpIamAccess:
    resourceType: cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/Project
    resource: //cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/projects/YOUR_PROJECT_ID
    roleBindings:
    - role: roles/compute.admin
maxRequestDuration: 3600s
eligibleUsers:
- principals:
  - user:bob@YOUR_DOMAIN
approvalWorkflow:
  manualApprovals:
    requireApproverJustification: true
    steps:
    - approvalsNeeded: 1
      approvers:
      - principals:
        - user:sam@YOUR_DOMAIN
requesterJustificationConfig:
  unstructured: {}</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud beta pam entitlements create temp-compute-admin \
  --entitlement-file=entitlement.yaml \
  --location=global \
  --project=$PROJECT_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Request access as Bob.** Sign in as Bob, open **Privileged Access Manager → My entitlements**, click **Request grant**, choose **30 minutes** and enter a reason.

4. **Approve as Sam.** Sign in as Sam, open **Approvals**, review the reason and approve.

5. **Use and lose the access.** Bob can now create a VM. After 30 minutes the role is removed automatically.

6. **Audit.** In **Privileged Access Manager → Grants**, see who asked, who approved, and when access ended.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Standing access | None for Bob |
| Grant | Temporary, approved, with a reason |
| Removal | Automatic when time runs out |
| Audit | Every request and approval logged |
